dialogOption.texten: 911, what's your emergency?

dialogOption.emotions: panicking, begging for help; door slam sound
dialogOption.texten: HELP! AAAAAA! . . . . There's a bat in my apartment!!!
{WHAT'S YOUR NAME?} What is your name?
Selina Kyle!
Talia al Ghul!
Julie Madison!
{WHERE ARE YOU?} What's your address?
345 Oxygen Road, apartment 52!
124 2nd Alley!
504 Basic Square!
{SHOULD I SEND... BATMAN?}So what do you want me to do... send... batman?
I don't care who you send, just send someone please!!!
{HIDE YOURSELF} The bat isn't gonna hurt you. It's more afraid of you than you are of it. Just close the door and stay calm.
I did, I'm in the toilet, but I can hear it flying around the whole apartment! I'm locked here, please help me!
{I'LL SEND HELP}Ok, I will send help, just stay there please.
{OPEN THE WINDOW} Ma'am, you can help yourself, just open the window wide and turn off the lights, before you know it the bat will be gone.
No way I'm going out of here!
{YOU HAVE TO} You have to, I am not gonna send an officer over there, your life is not in danger. It's not even an emergency, it's a bat in your house.
But oh... please! . . . . . . . . . [crying]
{BE CAREFUL} You can do it ma'am. Just be careful, ok?
{HANGUP} ....
No I can't.... I really can't....
Are you there?

reportElement.texten: The woman was extremely scared by a bat that flew into her apartment.
The operator tried to convince the woman to handle situation by herself.
The operator decided to end the conversation.
